pilot: Al recovery — EW -> 1D-LTE -> NLTE ladder, executed
status: PILOT — PROVISIONAL. See gf_caveat: the per-line A values are not yet trustworthy.
selection_basis: lines chosen BEFORE any abundance was computed: unexplained stage-2 drop, zero contaminants above 10% of own depth, observed depth >= 2%, chi2 <= 0.01, REW below the -4.9 linear ceiling. Agreement with literature is corroboration, NEVER the criterion (validate-don't-tune).
corroboration: the Al_Amarsi2020_PySME NLTE grid contains EXACTLY two wavelengths, 6696.02 and 6698.67 — the two recovered lines and no others. The grid was built for these lines; the committed pool never carried either.

what_the_pool_holds_instead.note: both over-claim absorption (34.53 mA fitted vs 7.41 absorbed; and 119.95 mA across the 6696 pair vs 66.48 absorbed) and BOTH are rejected by the pipeline's own EW sanity filter when re-run — 5 lines in, 2 out, and the 2 it keeps are the recovered pair

STOP.detail: EW errors of 4.2% and 4.7% account for ~0.02-0.04 dex. The 0.339 dex line-to-line spread is NOT measurement noise. It is LARGER than the Mg 5528-vs-5711 discordance of 0.21 dex that keeps Mg owed, so Al faces the same question and must not be promoted on the mean alone.
STOP.likely_cause: relative gf. Both lines share EP 3.1427 and differ only in log gf (-1.886 vs -2.249), both ungraded (nist_grade absent, K75 provenance). A relative gf error maps directly onto the spread.
STOP.next_rung: synthesis (3 further Al candidates incl. 6696.020 deblend) + a graded Al gf pull

gf_caveat.problem: The A(Al) values were computed through the pipeline's EW path, and I have NOT verified which log gf that path consumed. Three different values exist per line and they are 0.11-0.49 dex apart.
gf_caveat.systematic: linelist-summed minus canonical_gf is -0.113 dex for BOTH lines -- a consistent offset, so the two tables disagree systematically rather than randomly. That is a single-source violation worth its own finding regardless of Al.
gf_caveat.consequence: A 0.426/0.489 dex error would move the mean far off 6.43, so the fact that it landed there is weak evidence the path summed HFS correctly -- but agreement with literature is exactly the reasoning this project forbids, so it is NOT accepted as proof. The gf actually consumed must be read out of the EW path directly before the pilot number means anything.
gf_caveat.status_of_both_lines: adjudication_status = 'pending' in canonical_gf -- neither has ever been adjudicated
